compiled_state.description:
## Testing Mode
RED

## Story DD Coverage
- DD3: TrackerDefenseStore (review-defense-store.sh) reads/writes defenses keyed by (pr_number, commit_sha). Existing PR-keyed defenses remain readable via the sentinel-pr_number rule.

## Implementation Notes

Create `tests/scripts/test-review-defense-store-pr-keyed.sh` (or extend an existing review-defense-store test if present — verify via `ls tests/scripts/ | grep defense`).

**Test approach (Given / When / Then)**:
- Given: a fresh ticket-bound defense store
- When: `defense_store_write` is invoked with `--pr-number 42` AND a defense_text JSON payload
- Then: a DEFENSE_RECORD ticket comment is written embedding pr_number=42 in the record fingerprint AND the comment body

- Given: same store now has the v1.2.0 PR-42 defense plus a legacy v1.1.0-style DEFENSE_RECORD with no pr_number field
- When: `defense_store_list --pr-number 42` is invoked
- Then: returns the v1.2.0 PR-42 defense AND any legacy entry (sentinel matches any pr_number until next-cycle re-key)
- And: `defense_store_list --pr-number 99` returns only legacy/sentinel entries (no PR-42 v1.2.0 entry leaks)

Test fails RED because `--pr-number` parameter does not exist on defense_store_write/list yet.

Update `.test-index` with RED marker `[test_review_defense_store_pr_keyed]` for `plugins/dso/scripts/review-defense-store.sh`.
